caption: A bag of oranges tips over at the top of a staircase, and the oranges spill out and tumble down the stairs to the bottom.

sa.check: A bag containing oranges is present at the top of a staircase.
The bag tips over and oranges spill out of it.
The oranges travel down the stairs toward the bottom.
Several oranges are involved rather than a single one.
The tipping comes first, then the spill, then the tumble down the stairs.

pc.expect: Every orange that leaves the bag moves downward from step to step; only the steps, the walls or another orange stop or redirect it.
pc.fail: An orange rolls up a step or climbs the stairs; or hovers above a step; or stops in mid-air.

pc.expect: Each orange bounces off the step it hits and leaves it downward and away, no higher than where it came from; the oranges spread apart as they tumble.
pc.fail: An orange rebounds higher than the step it fell from; or reverses back up the staircase after a bounce; or all the oranges move as one rigid formation.

pc.expect: Oranges start moving only after the bag tips, and an orange that has come to rest stays at rest.
pc.fail: Oranges are rolling out before the bag tips; or an orange that has stopped on a step or the floor sets off again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The oranges stay round and firm through their impacts; they may bruise or split but do not flow or stretch.
pc.fail: An orange flattens like dough on landing and stays flat; or splashes like a liquid; or stretches as it falls.

pc.expect: The oranges keep their number and shape and the bag stays one bag; nothing passes through a step or through the bag.
pc.fail: Oranges appear from nowhere, vanish or merge; or an orange passes through a step or the bag's cloth; or an orange turns into a different object.

pc.expect: The staircase, walls and bag keep their colour and layout while the oranges tumble.
pc.fail: Steps change count or shape between frames; or the bag changes colour or size; or an orange changes colour mid-tumble.
